newsitem.title: USA: APAC says no news behind stock decline.
newsitem.headline: APAC says no news behind stock decline.

text.p: APAC TeleServices Inc said it knows of no news related to the fall in the company's stock price on Friday.
"There is no business event related to this," said David Bauer, a spokesman for APAC, adding the company did not issue any news releases on Friday.

Shares of APAC, which provides outsourced telephone-based sales for insurance, credit card and telecommunications clients, closed 3-1/4 lower at 29-3/4 after hitting a day's low of 28-1/2 in active trading.
Analysts said the fall was likely a result of profit taking and general pressure on the teleservices sector, which has in the past shown sharp gains.
"This whole sector has been under a lot of pressure...APAC perhaps even more so because it has been such a good performer," said Wayne Johnson, an analyst for Robertson Stephens.
